title: Tanshinone IIA alleviate atherosclerosis and hepatic steatosis via down-regulation of MAPKs/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Zhang, Yifan; Wang, Jiarou; Yang, Shuo; Kou, Haixin; Liu, Ping
one_liner_zh: 研究丹参酮IIA通过MAPKs/NF-kappaB通路缓解动脉粥样硬化和肝脂肪变性，仅用分子对接辅助验证靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关系微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Tanshinone IIA (Tan IIA) exhibits therapeutic potential for atherosclerosis (AS) and hepatic steatosis (HS). The study aims to explore the mechanisms underlying the anti-atherosclerosis and anti-hepatic steatosis effects of Tan IIA. METHODS: The LDLR(-/-)mice were divided into control, model, low/high Tan IIA and atorvastatin group, which fed with High-fat diet to build NAFLD-associated AS model, then administrated with 0.9 % saline, Tan IIA or atorvastatin. RAW264.7 cells divided into control, LPS, LPS plus low/high Tan IIA and LPS plus Tan IIA plus JNK activator group. The different goups' pathological changes visualized with H&E, Oil Red O and Immunofluorescence staining. The therapeutic effect of Tan IIA was reflected by lipids metabolism changes, hepatic indexes, inflammation levels. ELISA, RT-qPCR and Western blot assay were used to determine the inflammatory factors and upstream proteins. Molecular docking was used to reconfirm the importance of genes studied and locate the specific gene will study. RESULTS: Tan IIA alleviated LDLR(-/-)mice AS and HS by reducing AS plaque area, lowering serum &liver lipid levels (TC, TG), improving liver function (AST, ALT). Tan IIA decreased serum inflammation levels (IL-1beta, IL-6, TNF-alpha) and aorta & liver inflammatory-related cytokines levels (iNOS, VCAM-1, IL-6) and inhibited the phosphorylation of aorta & liver protein ERK1/2, JNK, p38 and NF-kappaB p65, which were validated in the LPS-stimulated macrophages supernatant and cells. CONCLUSIONS: The study indicated that Tan IIA can alleviate atherosclerosis and hepatic steatosis via down-regulating MAPKs/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. This provides a potential therapeutic strategy for the co-existing situation of atherosclerosis and hepatic steatosis.
abstract_zh: 目的：丹参酮IIA（Tan IIA）在动脉粥样硬化（AS）和肝脂肪变性（HS）中展现出治疗潜力。本研究旨在探讨Tan IIA抗动脉粥样硬化和抗肝脂肪变性作用的机制。方法：将LDLR(-/-)小鼠分为对照组、模型组、低/高剂量Tan IIA组和阿托伐他汀组，以高脂饮食喂养构建NAFLD相关AS模型，随后给予0.9%生理盐水、Tan IIA或阿托伐他汀处理。RAW264.7细胞分为对照组、LPS组、LPS加低/高剂量Tan IIA组以及LPS加Tan IIA加JNK激活剂组。通过H&E、油红O和免疫荧光染色观察不同组的病理变化。Tan IIA的治疗效果通过脂质代谢变化、肝脏指数和炎症水平反映。采用ELISA、RT-qPCR和Western blot检测炎症因子及上游蛋白。分子对接用于重新确认所研究基因的重要性并定位将具体研究的基因。结果：Tan IIA通过减少AS斑块面积、降低血清和肝脏脂质水平（TC、TG）、改善肝功能（AST、ALT）来缓解LDLR(-/-)小鼠的AS和HS。Tan IIA降低了血清炎症水平（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α）及主动脉和肝脏炎症相关细胞因子水平（iNOS、VCAM-1、IL-6），并抑制了主动脉和肝脏蛋白ERK1/2、JNK、p38及NF-κB p65的磷酸化，这些结果在LPS刺激的巨噬细胞上清液和细胞中得到了验证。结论：研究表明，Tan IIA可通过下调MAPKs/NF-κB信号通路来缓解动脉粥样硬化和肝脂肪变性。这为动脉粥样硬化和肝脂肪变性共存的情况提供了一种潜在的治疗策略。
